supersedes: docs/athlytica_metric_registry.json (written before protocol documents were read)

status_vocabulary.VERIFIED: Definition, unit, method and direction attested by a protocol document, or reproduced deterministically from data.
status_vocabulary.INFERRED: Reasonable reading of evidence, not attested. Review before any parent-facing use.
status_vocabulary.UNKNOWN: Exists in data but definition, derivation or direction cannot be established.
status_vocabulary.DEPRECATED: Superseded, redundant or structurally unsound. Retained for provenance.

promotion_rule: UNKNOWN is never silently promoted to VERIFIED. Promotion requires a named source document and a dated entry in DECISION_REGISTER.md.

capture_modes.COUNT: Tally producing a rate. Numerator and denominator both stored.
capture_modes.OBSERVE: Subjective ordinal assigned by a coach.

protocol_sources.file: Desktop/NRHL/Baseline Capture Sheets/Baseline capture sheet- Riverside.pdf
protocol_sources.note: Blank template. Defines 12 metrics + the 4-category per-session capture contract + discipline gating. Contains NO captured values.
Real measured values for ATH-043 (matches CSV corpus). Establishes the 1-10 band + text label pattern and the bilateral asymmetry threshold.
11 per-athlete audit PDFs with measured values. Derived from the 'Roller Hockey Parent Report' tab, which is absent from the local CSV corpus.

Prior extraction, evidence-graded. Where it disagrees with raw CSVs, the CSV wins. Its point formula was independently reproduced (31/31) and matches its own 94/94 reconciliation and NRHL_POINT_FORMULA in code.

per_session_capture_contract.correction_note: EE_TECHNICAL_BREAKS was classified as technical_skill in the v1 draft. The protocol places it under Effort/Engagement. Reclassified to dimension 'engagement'. It must not be aggregated into a technical composite.

metrics.name: sprint_20m
metrics.definition: Time to cover 20m from a standing start, off-skate, on a course marked with a 25m tape.
metrics.measurement_method: Marked 25m tape, standing start, measured before skates are put on.

validity_constraints.note: Reject values outside plausible child range; quarantine rather than clamp.

metrics.notes: Protocol VERIFIED. Zero captured values in the CSV corpus — the Riverside sheet is blank. Measured values may exist in the Parent Audit PDFs (see PERFID-MBATIA-FINAL: 20m = 3.84s). Cannot drive a composite until sample > 0.

metrics.name: broad_jump
metrics.definition: Horizontal distance of a standing two-foot broad jump.
metrics.measurement_method: Standing broad jump, distance measured from take-off line to nearest heel.
metrics.notes: Number of attempts is NOT specified by the protocol. PERFID-MBATIA-FINAL records Left 122cm / Right 101cm separately, implying a SINGLE-LEG variant also exists with a bilateral asymmetry delta. See GA_LATERAL_ASYMMETRY_CM.

metrics.name: lateral_asymmetry
metrics.definition: Absolute difference between left-leg and right-leg single-leg jump distance.
metrics.measurement_method: Single-leg broad jump each side; delta = |left - right|.

threshold_trigger.note: Threshold value at which the flag fired for ATH-043 (L122/R101). The actual THRESHOLD is not stated — 21cm is the observed firing value, not a documented cutoff.

metrics.notes: The metric is attested by a shipped athlete document, but the threshold that triggers 'BILATERAL CORRECTION REQUIRED' is not documented. Store left and right as separate raw observations; compute the delta. Do NOT store only the delta.

metrics.name: shuttle_5_10_5
metrics.definition: Pro-agility shuttle: 5m one way, 10m back, 5m return.
metrics.measurement_method: Timed, off-skate.

metrics.name: plank_hold
metrics.definition: Duration a front plank is held before technical failure.
metrics.measurement_method: Timed hold to failure.
metrics.notes: 'Technical failure' is not defined by the protocol. Two coaches may stop the clock at different points.

metrics.name: figure_8_speed
metrics.definition: Time to complete a figure-8 skating circuit.
metrics.measurement_method: Timed on-skate. Cone spacing NOT specified by the protocol.
metrics.notes: Cone spacing is load-bearing and undocumented. Two sessions with different spacing are not comparable. Record spacing as protocol metadata before any benchmark is built.

metrics.name: crossover_quality
metrics.definition: Coach's ordinal assessment of crossover technique.
metrics.measurement_method: Coach observation. 'Focus on form first, then speed.'
metrics.notes: The sheet states the 1-5 scale but does NOT provide rubric anchors, unlike the TC_* metrics which have 5 prose descriptors. Anchors should be authored before this drives anything.

metrics.name: tstop_power_brake
metrics.definition: Whether the athlete can execute a T-stop or power brake.
metrics.measurement_method: Coach observation, pass/fail checkbox.
metrics.notes: The sheet offers ONE checkbox pair for two named skills (T-Stop OR Power Brake). Which was performed is not recorded. Consider splitting into two metrics on the next sheet revision.

metrics.name: fwd_bwd_transition
metrics.definition: UNKNOWN.
metrics.measurement_method: UNKNOWN
metrics.notes: The row appears on the capture sheet with NO unit, NO scale and NO pass/fail box — every other row in block 2 has one. The instrument is undefined. Deliberately NOT guessed into an ordinal. Blocks on D-12.

metrics.name: stickhandling_weave
metrics.definition: Time to weave a cone set while maintaining puck/ball control.
metrics.measurement_method: Timed. Cone count and spacing NOT specified.
metrics.notes: Explicitly N/A for figure skating on the capture sheet.

metrics.name: target_accuracy
metrics.definition: Number of successful target hits out of 10 attempts.
metrics.measurement_method: 10 attempts at a target; count hits.
metrics.notes: Denominator is fixed at 10 by the protocol, so this is the one COUNT metric where the rate is directly comparable without storing the denominator separately.

metrics.name: spiral_glide_hold
metrics.definition: Duration a spiral or glide position is held.
metrics.measurement_method: Timed hold.
metrics.notes: Explicitly N/A for hockey and junior on the capture sheet.

metrics.name: one_foot_spin_rotations
metrics.definition: Completed rotations in a one-foot spin.
metrics.measurement_method: Count rotations until the spin breaks.

metrics.name: low_centre_of_gravity
metrics.definition: Coach's rubric-anchored assessment of stance depth and stability.
metrics.measurement_method: Coach selects one of five full prose descriptors. The complete descriptor string is the source value.
metrics.notes: Rubric-anchored, which is stronger than a bare ordinal. Column name drifts three ways across years including a literal backslash ('Low_Center_of\_Gravity', 2022) — see source_header_map.

metrics.name: full_extension_on_push
metrics.definition: Coach's rubric-anchored assessment of leg extension through the skating push.
metrics.measurement_method: Coach selects one of five full prose descriptors.

metrics.name: perfect_recovery
metrics.definition: Coach's rubric-anchored assessment of balance recovery after a disturbance.
metrics.measurement_method: Coach selects one of five full prose descriptors.

metrics.name: raw_dash_10m
metrics.definition: Timed 10m dash on skates, captured every session.
metrics.measurement_method: Timed on-skate 10m. Timing method (hand vs gate) NOT specified.
metrics.source: RIVERSIDE-2026-04-02 block 4; RAW DATA INPUT 2026 'Raw Time(10m dash)'
metrics.notes: The source column frequently contains the free text "Didn't manage to take the speed". That is CORRECT coach behaviour (refusing to invent a number) recorded in a numeric column. Load into observation.not_recorded_reason with quality_status='NOT_RECORDED'. Never 0, never bare NULL. PERFID-MBATIA-FINAL records 10m = 2.52s scored '8/10 -- Above Average', establishing the band+label presentation pattern.

metrics.name: technical_breaks
metrics.definition: Count of technique breakdowns observed during a session.
metrics.measurement_method: Coach tally. Definition of a 'break' is NOT documented.
metrics.notes: DIMENSION CORRECTED in v2: the protocol files this under Effort/Engagement, not Technical Compliance. It must NOT be aggregated into a technical composite. It is also confounded with exposure — a higher-performing athlete attempting harder work accumulates more breaks. This confound is the root cause of the DV_TECHNICAL_RATING inversion. THIS is the raw metric to migrate; DV_TECHNICAL_PRECISION is fully determined by it.

metrics.name: work_rate
metrics.definition: Coach's assessment of effort and engagement during the session.
metrics.measurement_method: Coach selects a labelled band, e.g. '5; Did the work but required constant prompting', '10; Lead the pack, high intensity, zero complains, set to finish drill'.
metrics.notes: Delimiter drifts between ';' and ':' across years, and label text is unstable ('complains' vs 'complaints'). Observed values cluster heavily at 5 and 10 — the intermediate scale may be unused in practice. Verify before benchmarking.

metrics.name: rate_of_perceived_exertion
metrics.definition: Perceived intensity of the session.
metrics.measurement_method: Recorded as a labelled band, e.g. '5 (Moderate)', '7 (High / Vigorous)'.
metrics.notes: NO DIRECTION: high RPE is neither good nor bad, it is a load descriptor. Both direction flags false. PROVENANCE CAVEAT: the source records this as coach-assigned; standard session-RPE is athlete-reported. Record whose perception it is.

metrics.name: passed_determinant_drill
metrics.definition: Whether the athlete passed the session's gating drill.
metrics.measurement_method: Coach pass/fail. The drill itself is free text in 'Determinant_Drill' and MUST be captured alongside.
metrics.notes: ENCODING DRIFT: 'TRUE'/'FALSE' in 2020, 'YES'/'NO' in 2022. A boolean is meaningless without the drill — 'Walk on grass' and 'Beginner stepovers' are not the same test, so this is NOT comparable across sessions without the drill string.

metrics.name: puck_gazing
metrics.definition: Degree to which the athlete keeps eyes up rather than fixating on the puck.

labels.3: Competent - scans before reception, lapses under pressure
labels.4: Elite - eyes-up every touch, scans before and after reception at full speed

metrics.measurement_method: Coach observation, scored every evaluated session.
metrics.notes: Fully rubric-anchored with a structural fix prescribed per level. No captured data in the CSV corpus.

metrics.name: panic_passing
metrics.definition: Quality and composure of passing under pressure.

labels.1: Chronic - blind backhand/hope pass at first pressure
labels.3: Competent - identifies receiver, timing slightly off
labels.4: Elite - calm, accurate, correct weight under heavy pressure

metrics.measurement_method: Coach observation, scored every evaluated session.

metrics.name: hero_complex
metrics.definition: Willingness to involve teammates rather than force solo play.

labels.1: Chronic - refuses to pass, holds >4s regardless of open teammates
labels.2: Developing - passes only when completely closed down
labels.3: Competent - shares puck, prefers solo in scoring areas
labels.4: Elite - proactively involves teammates, creates numerical overloads

metrics.measurement_method: Coach observation, scored every evaluated session.
metrics.notes: This deficit is the behavioural counterpart of NRHL-PTS-v1. The point formula prices a two-player goal at 4 points versus 1 for a solo finish — the same doctrine expressed as an incentive rather than an assessment.

metrics.name: static_positioning
metrics.definition: Continuity and quality of off-puck movement and support.

labels.2: Developing - occasional movement, defaults to static
labels.3: Competent - moves into support, timing/angle inconsistent
labels.4: Elite - continuous mobile support, always offers a lane at correct angle/depth

metrics.measurement_method: Coach observation, scored every evaluated session.

metrics.name: engagement_level_u8
metrics.definition: Athlete's engagement and wellbeing during the session.
metrics.measurement_method: Coach observation 1-4.
metrics.notes: WELLBEING SIGNAL, NOT PERFORMANCE. A score of 1 for 2 consecutive sessions triggers guardian consultation and a session-format override (20 min self-directed free play, coach observation only). EXCLUDED from every performance composite. The doctrinal constraint is explicit: 'A red flag is not a disciplinary action... The response is always environmental — change the constraint, not the player.'

metrics.name: technical_precision
metrics.definition: Linear restatement of the technical break count.
metrics.measurement_method: Not measured. Computed.
metrics.derivation_evidence: Verified on 265 of 265 rows of RAW DATA INPUT 2026, zero mismatches. Observed pairs (breaks, precision): (0,4) (1,2) (2,0) (3,-2) (4,-4).
metrics.notes: MUST NOT BE STORED AS A RAW OBSERVATION. Carries zero information beyond EE_TECHNICAL_BREAKS. The formula itself is correct and higher-is-better; the problem is downstream aggregation — see DV_TECHNICAL_RATING.

metrics.name: nrhl_points
metrics.definition: Scrimmage points, weighted to price assisted goals above solo goals.
metrics.measurement_method: Not measured. Computed from the stat line.
metrics.derivation_evidence: Three independent agreements: (1) dossier reconciles 94/94 per-fixture records with zero mismatches, and the integrity check assisted+solo==total_goals also holds 94/94; (2) independently re-solved during this audit from athlete_individual_stats.csv for 31/31 athletes with integer in-range splits; (3) matches NRHL_POINT_FORMULA = { assisted: 3, solo: 1, assist: 1 } in lib/services/nrhl-etl.ts. Doctrinal intent stated verbatim in Group sessions.csv Week 1: 'Unselfish play (3pts for assist goals)'.
metrics.notes: NOT the standard hockey points stat. Noel Inoue: goals+assists = 58, NRHL points = 124. A dashboard recomputing points conventionally halves every athlete. Always display with rule_version. Implements Coach's Manual constraint S4 (Shared Attack Rule): a two-player goal generates 4 points of team value versus 1 for a solo finish.

metrics.name: nrhl_composite
metrics.definition: Certificate-driving composite across attendance, coach grade and scrimmage output.
metrics.measurement_method: Not measured. Computed.
metrics.derivation_evidence: Dossier validates across all 18 certified athletes, maximum absolute residual 0.048, attributable to the sheet displaying attendance rounded to 1dp while computing on the full fraction.
metrics.source: Certificate Tracker tab (NOT present in the local CSV corpus); NRHL_CONTEXT_DOSSIER §2A.4
metrics.known_design_flaw: NOT CROSS-DISCIPLINE COMPARABLE. Attendance contributes up to 100 and coach grade up to 100, while the points term is 0-124 and is only reachable by athletes who play scrimmages. Five certified athletes (all Inline Skating) score a structural 0 on the points term, yet the percentile rank driving certificate tier is computed across the whole n=18 pool. Jaydan Morara (19 sessions, 100% attendance, 0 points) ranks below Luke Rashed (1 session, 4 points). Segment percentile by discipline before this drives any parent-facing award.
metrics.notes: The source tab is MISSING from the local corpus and must be recovered in the re-export. Certificate tiers: Elite All-Rounder >=90th percentile, Advanced >=70th, Core <70th, PERCENTRANK over n=18.

metrics.name: technical_rating
metrics.definition: Per-athlete mean of DV_TECHNICAL_PRECISION.
metrics.measurement_method: Not measured. Aggregated from a derived value.
metrics.source: athlete_individual_stats.csv 'technical_rating'; Athlete Progress.csv 'Avg Tech Precision'; DB column nrhl_athlete.technical_rating
metrics.notes: DIRECTION IS CONFOUNDED WITH EXPOSURE, NOT SIMPLY INVERTED. The underlying formula (4-2b) is correctly higher-is-better, but observed values invert against performance because higher-performing athletes attempt harder work and accumulate more breaks: Noel Inoue (top scorer, 124 pts) -1.667; Dakota Weening -2.0; Leroy Sila (40% attendance, speed 1.6) +2.4. Averaging a raw count and naming it a 'rating' hides the confound. NO historical value is overwritten, recomputed or deleted. technical_rating_v2 is NOT defined here — normalising by session count vs drill difficulty is Decision D-10. Both direction flags are null until D-10 resolves.
metrics.additional_defect: The two published rollups disagree on rounding: Raimi Skudi is -0.3 in Athlete Progress but -0.387 in athlete_individual_stats (-0.387 rounds to -0.4, not -0.3), so the aggregation windows or code differ. UNKNOWN which is correct.

metrics.name: low_cog_compliance_rate
metrics.definition: Proportion of observed sessions in which the athlete was compliant on TC_LOW_COG.
metrics.measurement_method: Not measured. Rate over an ordinal threshold.
metrics.derivation: count(TC_LOW_COG >= THRESHOLD) / count(TC_LOW_COG observed)  -- THRESHOLD UNDEFINED
metrics.notes: THE PHASE-AUDIT DRAFT WAS WRONG ABOUT THIS. It reported the columns as empty and concluded the data was absent. The raw ordinals are ABUNDANT (383 observations, all five levels attested: 21/86/173/90/13). The source rollup reports 0% for EVERY athlete, which is impossible against that distribution even at a '=5' threshold (13 attestations). The rollup formula in the Athlete Progress tab is BROKEN. Recomputable once the compliance threshold is decided — Decision D-09. Do NOT import from Athlete Progress. Do NOT record as 'no data'. Same applies to DV_COMPLIANCE_RATE_FULL_EXTENSION and DV_COMPLIANCE_RATE_PERFECT_RECOVERY.

metrics.name: speed_score_2026
metrics.definition: Banded speed score appearing only in the 2026 sheet.
metrics.measurement_method: UNKNOWN.
metrics.notes: Values are labelled ('6 (Average)', '8 (Great)'). CRITICALLY: populated in rows where PF_RAW_DASH_10M_S is the free text "Didn't manage to take the speed" — so it is NOT a function of the timed dash. Its inputs are unidentified. Blocks on D-12.

metrics.name: power_score_2026
metrics.definition: Computed power score appearing only in the 2026 sheet.
metrics.measurement_method: UNKNOWN.
metrics.notes: Values carry full float precision (4.333333333, 5.333333333, 3.0) — the signature of a spreadsheet formula averaging small integers. Inputs unidentified. Blocks on D-12.

metrics.name: session_load
metrics.definition: Training load for a session.
metrics.measurement_method: Not measured. Computed.
metrics.derivation: apparently EE_RPE * SESSION_DURATION_MIN (300 = 5*60, 420 = 7*60 in 2020 rows) -- NOT VERIFIED across the corpus
metrics.notes: STORED VALUE IS UNUSABLE: '#REF!' for 100% of 2022 rows (984 occurrences corpus-wide). Recompute from RPE x duration rather than importing. The formula is INFERRED from two 2020 rows, not attested by any protocol document. Blocks on D-14.

excluded_from_registry.name: VEO_CLIP_TAG
excluded_from_registry.reason: Verification evidence, not a performance metric. Belongs in the trust layer.

excluded_from_registry.name: GPS / venue verification confidence
excluded_from_registry.reason: Trust layer. 'Verification Confidence 93%' must never read as 'Performance 93%'.

excluded_from_registry.name: nrhl_metric.capture_confidence
excluded_from_registry.reason: Date-parse confidence, not measurement confidence. Belongs on observation.date_confidence.

excluded_from_registry.name: Payment_Status
excluded_from_registry.reason: Commerce. Routes to enrollment/registrations, never to an observation.

excluded_from_registry.name: Trend (Tech)
excluded_from_registry.reason: Athlete Progress column reading '↓ Needs Work' for every athlete — a formula output, not an assessment.

open_blockers.question: How should technical breaks be normalised for exposure before any rating is derived?
How is age tier established when DOB is not collected and age group is unstable per athlete?
What are the derivations / instruments? Recoverable only from the live sheet formulas.
Confirm RPE x duration, and how to treat 2022's 984 #REF! rows.

field_notes.protocol_version: null on derived metrics by design — a derived value has a rule_version (the calculation), not a capture protocol.
